main_text.p: Christo pertinere judicium, quando controversię, fidei ortę sunt in Ecclesiâ. Quæ doctrina à diversis Theologis tunc fuit refutata, speciatim à Cl. Walæo tract. de off. ministror. & auctoritate atq; inspectione quâ magistratus super ministros habere debet: contra Joh. Vtenbo-gard. Post Synodum in Confess. lua[?] & Apol. c. 25. §. 4. tribuunt quidē etiam Magistratui potestatem architectonicam in Ecclesiâ immediatè sub Christo; sed negât ejus jus aut officiū esse, ad decreta Synodica, ut ut verbo Dei conformia sint, observanda obligare homines suâ auctoritate, & potestate ullâ coactivâ uti in eâ parte. Negant etiam Magistratum jus habere in privatos cōventus, sed tantùm in exerci-tia quæ in Tēplis seu locis publicis ad Magistratum pertinentibus instituun-tur, ibid. Apol. fol..297. &c. Qui-bus duabus posterioribus negationi-bus revera tantum detrahunt Magi-stratus potestati, quantum ei in cæte-ris volunt videri tribuere; ut jam

page.notes: The word "lua" after "Confess." is doubtful; it may be an abbreviation or a different word, marked [?]. The page begins mid-sentence, so the first paragraph continues from the previous page. The printed "fol..297." has a double stop as printed. "etiamMagistratum" is printed without a space and is given here as two words. The line ending "jam" is followed by a dash-like mark, and the word continues on the next page. No catchword is printed.
